label: De ente source and GOD_4 classical root are one being by selected-root uniqueness
meaning: Analyst witness-identity composition, attribution deferred. On ONE carrier sigma.Being, grounding profile m, world w and q3 profile p: the De ente source n is an actual concrete root at w (ce7edf53). The classical God root g (da3facd6) satisfies PerfectRootAt, which itself contains 'every actual root of m at w equals g'. Hence n = g and both bodies hold of one being. De ente root EXISTENCE suffices; no separate root-uniqueness package (multiplication, grades or pure indiscernibility) is an input, because the classical endpoint already carries selected-root uniqueness and that carried commitment is retained, not removed. The bare GodExists projection loses this identity; this conclusion retains it. Neither endpoint's inputs (the De ente actuality/ground bridges; the 22-input classical-root bundle) are proved. GOD_4 is the nominal case predicate, not historical or Christian identification. See docs/notes/de-ente-esse-source-1628.md#same-witness-identities-for-1731-2026-11-18.

strong_version_needed.da3facd6-008e-5e76-92fa-677350c2dfdb: The weak versions (GOD_4 exists, unique classical God exists) are existential projections that forget the witness and its PerfectRootAt clause. The identity uses exactly that clause (every actual root of m at w equals the witness) and the conclusion retains the witness's full body, so no weak version suffices.
